method.registry_probe: Single bounded GET https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, 20s timeout, no pagination beyond the first page, sequential (no background loops). count = servers.length on page 1; capped=true when the page was full (100) and metadata.nextCursor was present. our_rank = 1-based index of the first row whose name matches /theluckystrike/i on that page (null if none on page 1). Three tokens (image, bank, kanban) additionally got one full-name confirmation probe (search=theluckystrike/<slug>) plus a two-page full listing of search=theluckystrike to settle whether the server exists in the registry AT ALL, not just off page 1 for a crowded token -- this was necessary because those three came back with zero matches on every token tried.
method.gsc: python3 + google-auth service account /Users/mike/.loop-creds/gsc-sa-key.json (client_email zovo-gsc-cleanup@zovo-extensions.iam.gserviceaccount.com), scope webmasters.readonly, site sc-domain:zovo.one (same property used in docs/GSC_RESULT.md). sitemaps().list for submitted/indexed counts; searchanalytics().query with dimensionFilterGroups page contains 'mcp.zovo.one', dimensions [page] and [query], last 7 full days (2026-08-28..2026-09-03) and a 28-day cross-check (2026-08-07..2026-09-03).
method.candidates: empty_slot_score = 100/(1+count) from a bounded single-page probe per token (same style as registry_probe). fit (0-1) = qualitative pairing with the 16-server suite (time/price/spreadsheet/invoice/kanban/expense/currency/docx/clauses/resume/pdf/calendar/timezone/recurring/image/bank-statement/office-suite). buildability (0-1) = pure-TypeScript-no-network feasibility gate. score = empty_slot_score x fit x buildability.
